item.title: A Boy Found $5,800 Of D.B. Cooper’s Ransom Money
item.description: D.B. Cooper parachuted from a hijacked jet with $200,000 in 1971. In 1980, a boy found $5,800 in bills whose serial numbers matched the ransom. Cooper’s identity and fate remain unknown; the FBI ended its active investigation in 2016.

item.title: Jennifer Dulos’ DNA Was Found In Discarded Trash Bags
item.description: Jennifer Dulos, a Connecticut mother of five, vanished in May 2019. Surveillance led police to discarded items carrying her DNA. Her estranged husband’s girlfriend, Michelle Troconis, was convicted of murder conspiracy in 2024 and sentenced to serve 14½ years. Jennifer’s body has never been found.

item.title: Daniel Robinson’s Father Seeks A Criminal Investigation
item.description: Geologist Daniel Robinson, 24, vanished after leaving an Arizona worksite in June 2021. His Jeep was later found overturned in a ravine. His father, David, wants a criminal investigation, while police say foul play is not suspected. Daniel remains missing.

item.title: Shelley Mook’s Ex Pocket-Dialed 911 While Discussing Her Case
item.description: Tennessee teacher Shelley Mook vanished in 2011 after dropping her daughter at her ex-husband’s home. A year later, Tyler Mook accidentally dialed 911 while discussing the case. He has not been charged in her disappearance, which remains unsolved.

item.title: Seth Techel Listed Every Gun Except The Murder Weapon
item.description: After Lisa Techel was killed in Iowa in 2012, her husband Seth omitted a shotgun from the firearms list he gave police. Investigators identified it as the murder weapon. Following two mistrials, he was convicted in 2014 and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: Chandler Halderson Faked College Emails To Fool His Father
item.description: Chandler Halderson impersonated college employees to make his parents believe he was still enrolled. Prosecutors said he killed Bart and Krista Halderson in Wisconsin in 2021 after his father uncovered the deception. He was convicted in 2022 and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: The Withheld Evidence That Ended Alec Baldwin’s Trial
item.description: Alec Baldwin’s manslaughter case over Halyna Hutchins’ death on the “Rust” set was permanently dismissed in 2024 after ammunition evidence was withheld. In September 2026, a judge dismissed most claims against prosecutors in his subsequent lawsuit, while allowing others to proceed.

item.title: She Vanished After Leaving A Bar With An Ex-Officer
item.description: Gretchen Fleming, 27, disappeared after leaving a Parkersburg, West Virginia, bar in December 2022. DNA testing identified remains found by a hunter in 2025. Former officer Preston Pierce, the last person seen with her, was charged with murder and kidnapping in 2026. He has pleaded not guilty.
